pages.text: $(thing)Farms$(): all.$(br2)Runs the farm on $(item)energy$() (FE, or the power of any energy mod) at $(item)diamond speed$(). It needs at least $(item)100 ME$() stored and holds 1000 ME. Pipes and cables feed it from any side.$(br2)The farm screen shows a red $(item)energy bar$() while the card is installed, and Jade shows an ME bar.$(br2)An $(item)energy generation mod$() must be installed: without one the card cannot be placed in a farm.
